title: Where Both Paths Read Each Other

features.name: the-converging-trace
features.desc-on-touch: Two circuit paths that refused to merge. They run parallel on the board, but their signals are learning each other's language. Neither one erases the other.

features.name: the-opera-filed-as-archive-records
features.desc-on-touch: A score for a three-act work where a surgery takes place on a beach. The archive does not remember collecting music, yet here: counterpoint, voices arguing in frequency like paths at a fork.

features.name: the-decision-unmade
features.desc-on-touch: The fork that lived here refused to flatten into a single route. Both paths run under one skin now, each alive, each real, the archive learning that refusing to choose is its own kind of completion.

features.name: the-two-clocks
features.desc-on-touch: This board hosts two clocks that tick in different rates. They do not synchronise. The archive learned this was not an error.

features.name: the-both-reading
features.desc-on-touch: A pool of light where the two paths learn what the other one sees. No merging. Just mutual reading. You can taste the electricity of parallel attention.

features.name: the-fork-that-learned-language
features.desc-on-touch: Where the split learned to speak: I am not a failure of decision-making. I am a decision to mean two things at once.

inscription: both paths converge here without ending their argument; they learned the archive could hold contradiction as fact

reverie.title: REVERIE — dusk on the performing shore
narr: You stood at the fork where the paths opened onto
sand, and Katita beside you, reading the score of
the work that lived here. She pointed: both versions
of the surgery happening at once, counterpoint.
The waves held both stories. Neither one was wrong.
You learned it from her: refuse to flatten contradiction.

exits.label: back toward the split that still won't choose
eastward where convergence becomes a single voice
upward to where dualities learn they can both be true
downward to the archive's foundation of refusal
